factor_name: Stress Residual Leadership with Downside Asymmetry

calculation.expression: 0.65*((residual_return_20d)/(residual_volatility_20d))+0.35*log(upside_residual_mean_30d/downside_residual_mean_30d), activated by lagged (benchmark_20d_return<0 OR residual_dispersion_20d>dispersion_120d_mean), lagged one day
calculation.description: Cross-asset residual momentum and payoff asymmetry signal evaluated during broad stress or elevated dispersion. Negative empirical IC is retained with direction -1, indicating contrarian use of the raw signal.

validation.regime_notes: No qualifying 2020-2023 dates due to warm-up windows; 2024-2026 IC -0.20158 (112 dates), 2027-2029 IC -0.00193 (640), 2030-2032 IC -0.00510 (479). Interpret small cross-section conservatively; sign direction is explicitly -1.
